containerDefinitions.name: xid-inject
command: echo "host: $(hostname)"; echo 'Waiting for the agent health monitor to connect to DCGM ...'; sleep 60; echo "=== injecting XID ${XID_CODE} into GPU ${GPU_ID} via ${DCGM_HOST} ==="; chroot /proc/1/root /usr/bin/dcgmi test --host "${DCGM_HOST}" --inject --gpuid "${GPU_ID}" -f 230 -v "${XID_CODE}" && echo INJECT_OK || echo "INJECT_FAILED rc=$? (dcgmi injection failed)"; echo 'Injection submitted. Idling for on-demand injection (ECS Exec) ...'; sleep 3600
